tone_statements.citation: 姜静 [Jiang Jing]. 2026. 彝语阿乌话施受关系的表达及与信息结构的互动 [The expression of readers-patient relations in Awu Yi and its interaction with information structure]. 《语言学论丛》 2026年第2期 (May 2026): 50-58 (continued p. 24). 北京大学. Open PDF:https://ccj.pku.edu.cn/Article/DownLoad?id=828197506883653&type=ArticleFile
tone_statements.quote: 彝语阿乌话的语音形态分为声调变化与元音屈折（其前身可能为两个音节的合音）。 1.2.1 声调变化（受施结构） 声调变化只限于第一、二人称代词。当人称代词位于句首作受事成分时，第一、二人称的声调在普通名 词论元作施事时需由 21 调变为 54 调；当人称代词论元作句首施事成分时，可变可不变。 [...] 彝语阿乌话的施事标记原始形态为 a²¹，与人称代词共现时，出现在人称代词之后，并发生合音现象， 使人称代词发生形态变化，元音屈折，声调由 21、54 调变为 213 调。此类形态变化是后期合音后形成的，
tone_statements.translation: The phonological morphology of Awu Yi consists of tone change and vowel ablaut (the latter probably from the fusion of two syllables). 1.2.1 Tone change (patient-agent construction): tone change is restricted to the 1st and 2nd person pronouns. When a pronoun stands sentence-initially as patient, the tone of the 1st/2nd person must change from tone 21 to tone 54 if the agent is a common noun; when the pronoun is a sentence-initial agent, the change is optional. [...] The original form of the Awu Yi agent marker is a21; when it co-occurs with a personal pronoun it follows the pronoun and fuses with it, so that the pronoun changes form: the vowel ablauts and the tone changes from 21 or 54 to 213. This kind of morphological change arose later, after fusion,
tone_statements.locator: p. 52, sections 1.2-1.2.1 (语音形态区分施受关系 / 声调变化) and 1.3 (施受标记区分施受关系)
tone_statements.summary: Tone values in use 55 54 33 21 213 (5, one contour 213); syllable-tone language; grammatical tone on pronouns: 21 -> 54 by argument role, pronoun+a21 fusion -> 213.

tone_statements.citation: Lama, Ziwo Qiu-Fuyuan. 2012. Subgrouping of Nisoic (Yi) languages: a study from the perspectives of shared innovation and phylogenetic estimation. PhD dissertation, University of Texas at Arlington. 399 pp.
tone_statements.quote: Lope 倮培 (Mile): The Lope [lo̠213phɯ̠21] people, or the Awu 阿务, live in Mile County, Yunnan. … The Lope language belongs to the Southeastern Yi Dialect according to Chen et al. 1985. Lope has one contour tone ([213] tonal value), which is not common in Nisoic languages. The internal classification of Lope is still unknown. Lope has 36 initials, 22 vowels (14 monophthongs, 7 diphthongs, and one triphthong), 5 tones (/55/, /44/, /33/, /213/, and /21/) (cf. YYFC 1983)
tone_statements.locator: p. 85, section 4.3 (Lope 倮培 profile); inventory repeated in Table 4.18 p. 107 and 4.4.2.4 Tones p. 109

sources.note: Morphosyntax article with a section (1.2 语音形态) on grammatical tone: 1st/2nd person pronouns ɣo21, na21 change 21 -> 54 when a sentence-initial patient precedes a common-noun readers (optional when they are initial readers); pronoun + readers marker a21 fuse to ɣua213, na213, ka213, sa213 (tone 21/54 -> 213); the noun readers marker is ɣɚ213; a further note that ɣo21 may surface as 54 without meaning change. Transcriptions throughout use tone values 55, 54, 33, 21, 213 (vs. YYFC/Lama 55 44 33 213 21). No inventory table; for that it cites Jiang 2025 弥勒阿乌彝语概况.
